items.headline: Western Michigan goes ahead late in the fourth, holds on for victory when Buffalo goes for the win
items.description: — Dieter Kelly kicked the go-ahead field goal with 79 seconds remaining and the Western Michigan defense held on fourth-and-goal with two seconds left in a 20-17 victory over Buffalo on Saturday in the Mid-American Conference opener for both teams.
